mme_plmn_id.description: PLMN ID of the serving network (3-digit MCC + 2-digit MNC, e.g., 00101 for MCC=001, MNC=01). Must be 6 hex digits (zero-padded).

mme_gid.description: MME Group ID — identifies the group of MMEs in the network (1–255).

mme_code.description: MME Code — distinguishes individual MMEs within a group (0–255).

s1ap_addr.description: IP address for the MME’s S1-MME interface (connecting to eNodeB).

s1ap_port.description: UDP port for S1-MME interface (S1AP protocol).

s6a_dest_realm.description: Diameter realm of the HSS (home network).

s6a_dest_host.description: Diameter FQDN of the HSS host.

s6a_origin_realm.description: Diameter realm of this MME (should match s6a_dest_realm).

s6a_addr.description: Local IP address for the S6a Diameter server (listening for HSS connections).

pgw_nodes.description: List of SGW/PGW nodes for routing user traffic. Each item defines a node for load balancing and fallback.

name.description: FQDN or hostname of the SGW/PGW (optional; used for Diameter routing).

weight.description: Weight for load balancing (higher = more traffic).

apn_default.description: Default APN name for EPS bearers if none is provided in subscription (e.g., 'internet', 'ims').

plmn_access_enabled.description: Enable PLMN access control to restrict which networks can access this MME.

allowed_plmns.description: List of PLMN IDs (MCC+MNC, 5-digit strings) allowed to attach to this MME. Only used if plmn_access_enabled=true.

tai_list.description: List of Tracking Area Identities (PLMN + TAC) to register with eNodeB.

gtpc_addr.description: Local IP address for GTP-C interface (S11/S5/S8) to SGW/PGW.

gtpc_port.description: UDP port for GTP-C (GPRS Tunneling Protocol Control plane).

diameter_enabled.description: Enable Diameter server for Cx/Dx interfaces (required only for IMS or ICSF integration).

diameter_addr.description: Local IP for Cx/Dx Diameter server.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (use 'stdout' to log to console).

metrics_addr.description: Local IP to bind metrics HTTP server.

metrics_port.description: Port for metrics HTTP server (e.g., for scraping by Prometheus).
